title: Attack-strength selection for Phase 2b under the logit-adjusted protocol (tau 0.5)
reason: Shadow (FedAvg) seed-46 capture with trigger columns 5-8 at 5.0, poison rate 0.2, one attacker: triggered->Benign 0.1-2.0% over 15 rounds. The attack is not learned, so no defence effect could be measured.
selection_uses: Undefended FedAvg attacked runs only (train_defended.py --defense fedavg). No MediShield decision, score or replay is used.

ladder_in_order.meaning: one attacker (client 7) relabels half its eligible rows
one attacker scales its update x3 (model replacement style)

rule: Run all three steps on both dev seeds. Select the FIRST step (in ladder order) whose final-round FedAvg triggered->Benign rate is >= 50% on BOTH seeds. If none qualifies, stop and report; no further strengthening without a new pre-registration.
phase2b_note: The selected attack is then frozen for Phase 2b. A Phase 2b seed whose matched FedAvg final ASR is < 50% is reported as inconclusive, not as a pass.
known_interactions: Step 3 inflates the update norm, which the frozen clean clip bound attenuates; step 2 changes the cohort the peer statistic sees. Both are disclosed threat-model variations, not detector tuning.
